rationale.intuition: Penn overall ~5.4%, ED admit ~14.2%. GPA 3.80 is below Penn's 25th-percentile (Penn typical mid-50% GPA 3.91-4.0) — weak academic axis. BUT legacy + ED is a documented stacking case at Penn (Daily Pennsylvanian 2023 reported legacy admit ~33%; ED legacy admit even higher). URM contextual signal stacks on top. Counselor consensus 15-40% for legacy + URM-coded + ED applicant even with sub-25th GPA. Lower bound floors near Penn ED baseline (14%); upper bound caps at historical legacy ED admit rate (~40%).
